description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom widget extending TextView, designed to display log messages received via the LogNode interface. It formats log data, including priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and appends it to the view, also supporting chaining of LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface, formats them, and appends to the display. Supports chaining with other LogNode instances.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView, handling different initialization scenarios.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and exception. Uses Android's Log class to determine priority string and stack trace. Ensures UI thread update.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder if it is not null, with a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the log display.
